Part 2 (continued):

6. SUGGESTION — browser_ext/sw/main.js:240,262 (~277)
The SW logs hub URLs to its console: `console.log('[dap-hub] connection saved:', url || '(cleared)'…)` (line 240), `'[dap-hub] saved connections list set:'` (262, count-only — fine), and `'[dap-hub] switched active connection →', entry.url` (~line 277). Panel-supplied/bookmarked URLs can legitimately carry `?token=`/`dap_token=` query credentials (enrollment URLs are only normalized in the app, not in the SW path), which contradicts the codebase's own "never log a credentialed URI" rule used everywhere else. Fix: log scheme+host only, or strip query/fragment before logging.

7. SUGGESTION — flutter_app/lib/services/dap_enrollment_service.dart:154-167
When the keychain is unavailable (web always — KeychainStore.isSupported is false off iOS/macOS/Android; Linux/Windows desktop too), the enrollment store silently persists the invite `priv` + `clientSecret` as a PLAINTEXT JSON file via ExecutionEnv (IndexedDB on web). The class doc mentions the fallback, but nothing surfaces it: a web user pasting an invite gets at-rest key material with no indication it is not hardware/keystore-protected. Fix: surface "stored unencrypted on this platform" in the enrollment result/UI, or gate invite enrollment to keychain-capable platforms.

8. SUGGESTION — flutter_app/lib/network/network_session.dart:512-516,529-539
Two unsynchronized mutations of ChannelState: (a) each realtime envelope is decoded via `unawaited(_onEnvelope(...))` — concurrent async decrypts can append messages out of order; (b) `_refreshAfterReconnect` clears `state.messages`/`state.seen` and reloads without checking `state.loading`, so a `loadOlder` page in flight lands its (now stale, cursor-based) inserts into the rebuilt store after the fresh page — duplicates or lost tail messages around reconnects. Fix: a per-channel serialization queue (or at least skip refresh while `loading`).

9. SUGGESTION — flutter_app/lib/network/fa_network_ws.dart:149
`_outbox` is an unbounded `List<String>`: while the socket is down (laptop closed, `network.offline`), every `sendEnvelope` appends ciphertext frames to memory with no cap, then flushes everything at once on reconnect. Fix: cap (e.g. a few hundred), drop-oldest, and surface a WsError when the cap is hit.

10. SUGGESTION — flutter_app/lib/network/models.dart:523-531
`PublicNetworkInfo.fromJson` THROWS on a malformed item, and `FaNetworkClient.listPublicNetworks` catches only `FaNetworkException` — so one malformed directory item in an otherwise-200 response escapes the method's documented "it never throws into the widget tree" contract. Today's sole caller (networks_sidebar `_fetchPublicNetworks`) masks it with `on Object`, but the contract and code disagree. Fix: skip malformed items via a tolerant parse returning null, like the other models in this file.

11. SUGGESTION — browser_ext/dart/src/dap/dap_client.dart:222-227
`_byName` does `agent['agentId'] as String` / `agent['x25519'] as String?` over hub-supplied presence rows (lazy `.cast` maps). A malformed row from a buggy/malicious hub throws a raw TypeError out of the `dap_dm` tool instead of the descriptive StateErrors the method otherwise promises. Fix: extract via `is String` checks and skip malformed rows.

12. SUGGESTION — flutter_app/lib/network/channel_chat_service.dart:137-145
`_mentionEnd` treats `'` as a terminator, so "@al's" resolves a mention for member "al" — a false-positive mention id rides the envelope and can spuriously wake that agent server-side. Fix: drop apostrophe from the terminator set (or require whitespace/end after a name that is a prefix of a word).

CLEAN (one line each): hub_crypto.dart and hub_identity.dart — sound (shape-only fanet1 detection has an explicit legacy fallback contract; HKDF/signature code clean). lib/src/plugins/plugin.dart and lib/src/task/subagent_scope.dart — clean. invite_codec.dart — strict/tolerant split is deliberate and correct; keys ride the fragment only. ws_connector_web.dart / agent_network_transport_web.dart / hub_transport.dart — token-in-`?token=` is unavoidable on web, explicitly acknowledged with a server-side redaction contract, and error paths are sanitized. project_mount_env.dart — mapping is idempotent and consistent; SessionCwd/AppStorageCwd unwrapping is careful (secrets stay in app storage). dap_frames.dart — clean. dap_service_web_core.dart — sanitizes worker errors, does not relay credentialed URIs. fa_network_ws.dart frame parsing — malformed frames never crash (all wrapped into WsError); disconnect-during-connect handled. channel_rail.dart / networks_sidebar.dart — delete channel/agent/member/network ALL have confirmation dialogs; l10n used throughout; hub bearer never logged (only token class). packages/fa_ui chat_composer + app adapter — interceptor runs BEFORE analytics/sendText, also inspects a single staged .txt chip so an invite cannot reach the model via sendAttachments; failed sends restore the draft. add_agent_dialog — clientSecret shown once with explicit copy; invites keep keys in the URI fragment. channel_chat_service mention resolution — correct substring + boundary logic otherwise (no regex, no case tricks). sw/main.js hub.join — persists only after validating the keypair pair-ness and never logs credentials; waitForHubJoin polls status without logging.

Not re-reported (covered by prior round per instructions): hub_messaging_repository redaction, dap_secret_redaction, dap_env_channels, etc.
